description: agent-hierarchy — SessionStart injects the resolved role→model table and the orchestration protocol on startup, resume, clear, fork, and post-compaction (so it survives compaction). Main session only — SessionStart does not fire for subagents, and that suppression is intended here: role agents carry their own instructions in agents/*.md, and an Implementor that starts orchestrating would defeat the hierarchy. Silent when the config sets enabled:false; with no config at all it emits a one-line nudge to run /hierarchy init. PreToolUse gates Ultra-Advisor escalation on the user: the first dispatch of each session is denied with instructions to put the decision to the user and record their answer (allow this session / ask each time / blocked this session) via hooks/gate.mjs; the answer is session-scoped and lives in ~/.claude/agent-hierarchy.gate.json. Every other tool call passes through untouched. SubagentStop runs the usage collector: it sums the finished subagent's transcript (token counts the harness already logged) into ~/.claude/agent-hierarchy.usage.jsonl — plain node, zero model cost — which /hierarchy usage or hooks/usage-report.mjs renders as session/day/week/month reports.
